title: Dreamy Private Studio Retreat - modern & spotless
description:
Modern, clean, basement apartment with your very own private/ external entrance (you have sole occupancy of the 375 sq/ft apartment, and our family is upstairs, with no access to your room... meaning our guests only interact with us if that is their vibe...) on a beautiful acre of land, with secure parking  in East Nashville. An easy 10 minute Uber to downtown, Ryman Auditorium, Broadway, Nissan Stadium and even less to hipster 5-points or the Grand Ole Opry.

The space
This is a relaxing space! We renovated the basement in isolation from the rest of our house so that our parents can stay for LONG periods of time when they visit from Australia.

Everything is new! We love the gas log fireplace and and modern bathroom. The kitchen will serve your basic needs, though you are in a foodie neighborhood, so you probably don't want to spend all of your time heating frozen meals :)

Our backyard is massive, and we hope you'll get a chance to enjoy it.

The TV is connected to Netflix, Hulu and Amazon.
